sb1.title: What Senate Bill 1 says

items.quote: The continuation of existing diversity, equity, and inclusion offices or departments
items.lead: Each state college must adopt a policy prohibiting

items.quote: The establishment of any new institutional scholarships that use diversity, equity, and inclusion in any manner
hold every individual to equal standards, and provide those individuals with equality of opportunity
items.lead: For every position, policy, program and activity, including internships and student life programs, each state college must

items.quote: Nothing in this section prohibits a state institution of higher education from complying with any state or federal law to provide disability services or to permit student organizations, including fraternities and sororities.

source.cite: Sub. S.B. 1, 136th General Assembly, as enrolled (effective June 27, 2025)

sb1.note: These provisions govern Ohio’s public colleges and universities. The law bars institutional DEI offices and new institutional DEI scholarships and sets equal-opportunity standards for university activities, including student life.

supporters.label: What supporters of Senate Bill 1 argue
supporters.quote: DEI programs … are inherently discriminatory, and should not be supported by taxpayers.
supporters.who: Sen. Jerry Cirino, the bill’s sponsor

outcome.text: Changes in membership, sponsorship and university support before and after SB 1 need to be checked against chapter records.
